purpose: Teach: 劣っ/裏返し/裏腹/正しかっ/小柄/可愛らしい/起っ/つくれ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに知識で劣っても努力で追いつくわよ
lines.en: Sho, even if your dad has more knowledge, you can catch up through effort.
lines.style: Warm, encouraging. Soft opening on his name. Steady, even pacing. A gentle hand on his shoulder in the voice — maternal without being condescending. Close and intimate.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、靴下を裏返しに履いてたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was wearing my socks inside out the whole time.
lines.style: Shy, slightly embarrassed laugh underneath. Quick delivery. Self-aware and a little self-deprecating. The small voice of a kid admitting something he didn't notice until just now.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは寡黙と裏腹に詩を書かれるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad might be quiet, but beneath that he writes poetry.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Warm reverence in the voice. Slow, deliberate pacing. Like she's seeing something about his father that he hasn't quite understood yet. Soft trailing off on 'poetry'.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、自分の意見が正しかったって嬉しかったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was so happy when I realized my idea was actually right.
lines.style: Bright, open eagerness. Quick tempo with excitement underneath. The rush of a child who's just had something click into place. Unguarded and genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは小柄でも力強いわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad might be small, but he's got real strength.
lines.style: Soft, affirming tone. Warm recognition. Gentle pace. Like she's showing him something he already knows but needs to hear said out loud. A nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが可愛らしい絵を描いて下さったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad drew me the cutest picture.
lines.style: Pure, unfiltered joy. Lighter pitch. Quick bursts separated by small breaths of delight. The voice of a child showing off something precious he got from someone he loves.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、公園で楽しい遊びが起ってきそうね
lines.en: Sho, it seems like some really fun adventures are starting to happen at the park.
lines.style: Gentle optimism. Inviting, open tone. Moderate pace with a lift toward the end. Like she's painting a picture he's about to step into. Knowing and pleased.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとパズルをつくれて嬉しかったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was so happy that Dad and I got to build a puzzle together.
lines.style: Soft contentment in the voice. Warm, unhurried pacing. The small, genuine happiness of a child recounting a quiet, good moment. Intimate and unperformed.
